summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Axistra Compliance + Accounting Portal. 46/46 backend pytest tests PASSED across auth, dashboard, customers, recharges (audit chain match/mismatch), invoices (with PDF/HTML fallback), treasury, expenses, all 10 reports + CSV/Excel exports, compliance actions, Magnus placeholder, and audit logs. Frontend login works with seed admin, dashboard renders KPIs/chart/VAT tracker, sidebar nav reaches all 13 sections, customer Add modal opens with all required fields, settings page shows correct TRN 105415374500001 + IFZA + AED 375K thresholds + 6-step audit chain, logout returns to /login. All key data-testids (login-*, sidebar-nav-*, add-customer-btn, new-recharge-btn, audit-chain, audit-step-*, action-record-crypto, action-magnus-credit, action-okx-wio, action-refund, mismatch-warning, download-invoice-btn) confirmed present in source.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 201 instead of conventional 200 for login success (NestJS @Post default). Functional but non-standard.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on first paint due to flex container sizing — visual chart still renders correctly after layout settles.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Align sidebar nav data-testids with review spec: 'sidebar-nav-pl' → 'sidebar-nav-profit-loss', 'sidebar-nav-audit' → 'sidebar-nav-audit-logs' for naming consistency with route paths.
(Optional) Add @HttpCode(200) to AuthController.login so login returns 200 instead of 201 — purely cosmetic.
(Optional) Suppress Recharts width/height warnings on Dashboard by ensuring ResponsiveContainer has a deterministic parent height.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py FastAPI proxy correctly forwards /api/* to NestJS on 9001 with hop-by-hop header stripping — clean implementation.
RechargesService.create auto-generates invoice via InvoicesService and pre-seeds TreasuryMovement — audit chain pre-conditions met. Good.
Magnus sync correctly compares parseFloat(amount) vs parseFloat(magnus_credit_added) with 0.01 tolerance and writes reconciliation_note on mismatch — verified via test.
Invoices PDF endpoint falls back to HTML when Puppeteer/Chromium unavailable and sets correct Content-Type. Good resilience.
ComplianceLog entity uses field 'action' (not 'action_type') — frontend log calls must use 'action'. Confirm Compliance.jsx aligns.
Expense entity requires vendor_name (non-nullable) — frontend Expenses.jsx must enforce this on create form.
AppLayout sidebar testids deviate from review naming convention for profit-loss & audit-logs (minor).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all routes load, modals/buttons present, audit chain stepper renders 6 steps

seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_-prefixed customers, recharges (RCH-2026-*), invoices (AX-2026-*), treasury movements, expenses, and compliance logs in PostgreSQL. No teardown — left for future regression visibility.

Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://crypto-audit-chain.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v.
